annotations.text:
COLOUR CARRIES TWO THINGS AT ONCE

Pin fill = status (green today, soft yellow ahead, grey done or past).
Small dot beside each day header = that day's own hue.

I did not put the day hue on the pins - with 11 days you get 11 hues and the today/done reading disappears. Open question 1 below.

TRY IT

The first artboard is live. Tap a day header to open it, tap a stop to expand the actions, tap Visited to grey it out. Tap the grab handle to throw the sheet to full screen.

THE RISKY PART

Google has no public API for a saved list. These two screens assume we resolve a shared list link server-side and match its places against the sheet by name. Expect a hand-matching step - that is what the Reconcile screen is for. Details in PLAN.md.

Three ways to shape the day list. A is what the app screens are built on, because it is what you described. B and C are here so you can see what you are giving up. They are sketches, not proposals - say the word and I will build one out properly.
